summary: Tested the live preview frontend and requested backend routes. Mocked frontend login, organization/customer navigation, creation modals, print preview, ledger expansion, WhatsApp share, logout, and mobile overflow mostly work; the live backend is still the starter FastAPI app and all requested AccountEase routes return 404.

critical.issue: Both valid and invalid login requests return 404 because the running backend exposes only starter status routes.
Organization and customer GET routes return 404; the frontend therefore cannot use the live service.
Transaction GET route with date parameters returns 404.

integration_issues.issue: Apply action only shows a success toast; records remain unchanged because Ledger assigns filtered = customer.records and never applies from/to values.

action_items: Wire supervisor to the implemented Spring Boot API or implement the requested routes in the running FastAPI service, including persistence and JWT auth.
Implement actual ledger date filtering and verify inclusive date-range behavior.
Replace frontend local seeded state with live API calls after backend routes are available.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/server.py is still the starter MongoDB status-check application, so the Java controller and PostgreSQL schema are not running.
ApiController GET customer and transaction methods return placeholder empty lists and POST methods do not persist data; this is insufficient for the requested ledger product.
The frontend hardcodes demo authentication and all domain state locally, so successful preview interactions are MOCKED and do not validate backend integration.

success_rate.frontend: 90% of exercised checks; date filtering failed

seed_data_creation: No persistent seed data created; frontend-only seeded demo state was used.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Demo credentials were supplied by the request as rajesh/demo123; test_credentials.md is empty. Re-run backend regression after the running service is switched to the AccountEase implementation, then verify API-backed create/search/ledger persistence.
rca of the issue: The process supervised on port 8001 runs backend/server.py, which defines only /api/, /api/status, and POST /api/status. The requested Java source under backend/src/main/java is not compiled or launched (mvn is unavailable). Separately, Ledger.js-equivalent code in App.js sets const filtered = customer.records, so date inputs cannot alter the displayed records.
